faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Key notes about uploads, diagnosis, rewriting, and privacy.

items.question: Will it invent my experience?
items.answer: ResumeFit AI must not add metrics, scope, outcomes, or experience not present in your resume. When information is missing, it preserves the original meaning and asks you to provide or verify details.

items.question: Can I use it without a full JD?
items.answer: Yes. You can enter a role direction such as AI Product Manager or Growth Marketing. A full JD makes the diagnosis more specific.

items.question: Which formats are supported?
items.answer: V1 supports PDF, DOCX, and text. Text PDFs and DOCX files can be extracted directly; if a file cannot be extracted, paste the resume text to continue.

items.question: Are uploads used for training?
items.answer: ResumeFit AI does not use uploads to train its own models or write resume text/JDs to its business database. Content is temporarily held in this browser tab and sent to the configured AI service provider for diagnosis or optimization; the provider's own data-use and retention terms apply. Avoid uploading sensitive details.
